description: Contract for the pre-publication evidence gate (implementation spec section 4.4, lines 1169-1186, plus the evidence-gate field list of 2.2). Produced by src/authorized_assessment/reporting/evidence_gate.py with a dependency-free subset validator. A report must be rejected before publication when any listed violation fires; violation details must never echo credential values.

gate_notes.evidence_root: The gate takes a required filesystem root; evidence_ref paths are resolved against it (absolute paths are honored as-is). Fail-closed: a missing root cannot be excused because path existence is one of the spec 4.4 rejections.
gate_notes.empty_source_ledger: Optional source_ledger check covering the spec 13.2 negative example: a missing or zero-row ledger yields empty_source_ledger.
gate_notes.credential_content_scan: The value-content scan is intentionally over-inclusive (fail-closed): any credential-like assignment pattern (Cookie:/Authorization:/token=/session_key=/AppSecret=/password= ...) in report text is a violation. Reports must reference evidence files, never carry raw credential-bearing text.
gate_notes.violation_details: Violation details record the JSON location only, never the matched credential text.

invariants: gate_status == PASS if and only if violations is empty
rows_checked must equal the number of published finding rows evaluated
every violation code must be one of violation_codes
a finding row presented as confirmed requires finding_status == confirmed (candidate_presented_as_confirmed otherwise); a missing finding_status is itself a violation
finding_status == confirmed or disposition == accepted_risk rows require non-empty reviewer and reviewed_at
finding_status == confirmed rows require validation_result == verified
credential-like keys and credential-like assignment patterns in values are violations; violation details must not contain the matched credential text
credential-like keys are forbidden anywhere in the gate report payload; the exact key 'authorization' is exempt because it may only name a header category in scan patterns
